name: Gravity Well
sensor: Triggered: a crew member comes within 3 tiles
effect_level_1: Pulls everyone within 3 tiles to its centre and holds them 2 seconds. No damage.

name: Crystal Wall
effect_level_1: A breakable wall (800 health) that blocks a path. It can never close the last route to the Heart.

name: Time Snare
sensor: Triggered: a crew member steps on its tile
effect_level_1: Freezes that character for 2.5 seconds. No damage.

name: Static Coil
effect_level_1: Shocks everyone within 2 tiles every 3 seconds, for 8% of their maximum health a shock.
seen: Hidden until revealed or it first shocks

name: Thorn Hedge
effect_level_1: Blocks a path and hurts anyone pushing through, 5% of their health a second while they are in it.

name: Lantern Glare
sensor: Triggered: a crew member comes within 2 tiles
effect_level_1: Shows the crew to every guard within 4 m of it for 5 seconds (8 m from alarm level 4, 12.17) and blinds the crew for 2. No damage. A fixed reach, which laws that widen the alarm do not change.
